data.title: 便利店屋檐下的罐装热咖啡
data.location: 深夜微雨的街角便利店玻璃橱窗外
data.lighting: 便利店冷白荧光灯与雨夜路灯暖光
data.prompt: 1girl, solo, shiki_natsume, dark olive cropped utility jacket, black ribbed tank top, high-waist straight blue jeans, standing under convenience store awning, offering warm canned coffee toward viewer, holding second coffee can in other hand, calm deadpan gaze with faint blush, raindrops falling off eaves foreground, softly blurred warm convenience store glass behind, cool overhead fluorescent light, wet asphalt reflections, medium shot
data.animaCaption: Sheltering under the dripping awning in her dark olive utility jacket, she extends a hot canned coffee toward you while cradling a second tin in her other hand. Overhead awning light outlines her dark hair against the glistening night street.
data.promptProse: Framed beneath the dripping roof edge of a corner convenience store on a rainy night, Shiki Natsume stands casually in a dark olive cropped utility jacket over a black ribbed top and straight high-waisted jeans. Holding one steaming coffee tin in her left hand, she offers a second warm canned coffee toward the viewer with her signature calm gaze and a faint flush at her ears while cool overhead light and warm wet-street reflections shimmer behind her.
data.story: 细雨把深夜的柏油路淋得发亮。夏目在便利店屋檐下停住脚步，面无表情地把刚买的热黑咖啡直接贴上你冰凉的手背——「手这么冰，明天感冒了谁替我搬咖啡豆？快拿着暖手。」
